authorization.rule: Each call checks current caller membership before disclosing batch or projection data. The owner-only TEST ONLY finalizer may inspect Approved output during acceptance.

input.candidateManifest: Exact pending manifest produced by PA-37A

precommit: Resolve exactly one Ready batch with an exact pending manifest.
Require at least one source item and no more than 5000; zero unresolved, reconciled approved/excluded/item counts, and no invalid review items.

Reread the source list bound to the batch over the complete closed interval, including IDs beyond the materialization high-water mark, and reject late arrivals or changed captured ETags/encoded bytes.
Reread every review item and compare its complete draft bytes, ETag, version, decision, reason, candidate ID, mapping, and candidate bytes with the pending manifest.
Reject duplicate source IDs, duplicate approved IDs, missing/cyclic/dangling ancestry, and any included correction whose predecessor is excluded or unresolved.
Conditionally change Ready to Finalizing using the batch item ETag; a competing request must return a non-visible conflict or in-progress result.

freeze.rule: Write each included candidate as exact UTF-8 bytes, reread every file, and compare complete bytes. Excluded items get no projection file. Write and exactly reread the complete mapping/count/ordering manifest last.
freeze.digest: Store a named non-cryptographic b64-edge-v1 fingerprint for diagnostics only. Exact file bytes and list ETags/versions are the integrity checks.
freeze.bounds: At most 5000 approved and excluded source rows and 10 MiB of combined JSONL; fail closed before publication if either limit is exceeded.

commit.rule: Only after every frozen file and the manifest reread exactly may a conditional SharePoint item update set State to Approved, ApprovedByEmail and ApprovedAtUtc once, and ProjectionDigest to the frozen fingerprint. The app and exporter cannot perform this update.
commit.readRule: Read Approved Batch TEST ONLY returns only an Approved manifest and its exact frozen bytes; Draft, Ready, Finalizing, and Failed reveal no projection content.
commit.duplicate: An Approved request returns the existing immutable manifest. A Finalizing request returns in-progress without a second writer. An uncertain precommit result remains non-visible until an operator resolves it.

failure.rule: A failed or timed-out read, conditional write, file write, or exact readback never sets Approved. Preserve existing source receipts and files for diagnosis; never reconstruct approved content from mutable drafts after a failed commit.
failure.rollback: The collected exporter remains unchanged and sees only Approved batches; it cannot read pending candidate files.
